campaign_name: PR-PLAY Post-Optimization Gameplay Evaluation and Failure Triage
purpose: Evaluate whether the current engine can sustain a short continuation without live provider calls, and name the single largest remaining playability obstacle.
executive_summary: Evaluation verdict A/PASS. The twelve-turn continuation is not a sustainable conversation. Live provider calls: 0. PR-PLAY-80 was not opened. No production code was changed. One grounded Guard Captain answer and one authored move to Old Milestone succeeded. After the captain's answer, conversational orchestration reused that sentence for a notice reading and a mud-copy improvisation, treated a walk to the visible notice board as unestablished travel, and turned a recall of the notice into an address clarification. The player never heard the notice. Three provider-disabled or retry fallback sentences were published as completed runtime responses. The retreat at Old Milestone was a correct operational refusal and did not enter primary narration. Local TestClient time was 1598.794 ms and is not live latency. A separate budget probe refused a 28000-token estimate before dispatch and admitted a 100-token estimate to a local stub. Focused AT-OPT tests passed 61. Dedup, same-scene instruction selection, and the full-instruction safeguard were not exercised by the chat turns. The next action is a targeted orchestration repair. Do not implement it from this handoff. Do not launch live play and do not open PR-PLAY-80.

A gameplay measurement of mixed-key dedup and of the plan-backed full instruction list.
does_not_prove: It does not prove live-model prose quality.

It does not authorize PR-PLAY-80, AT-OPT-07, or a production opening cap of 3000.
recommended_next_step: Repair conversational orchestration so a new notice, inspection, or recall intent is not answered with the previous NPC sentence, and a visible interactable is not an unestablished destination. Keep the genuine-repeat, unknown-place, and disabled-retreat controls. Do not implement that repair from this handoff. Do not open PR-PLAY-80. Do not launch live play until that boundary is repaired.
